ja338:1.1: Viditaṃ thusaṃ undurānaṃ, viditaṃ pana taṇḍulaṃ, thusaṃ thusaṃ vivajjetvā taṇḍulaṃ pana khādare ti.
ja338:2.1: Yā mantaṇā araññasmiṃ yā ca gāme nikaṇṇikā yañ c' etaṃ iti c' īti ca etam pi viditaṃ mayā ti.
ja338:3.1: Dhammena kira jātassa pitā puttassa makkaṭo daharass' eva santassa dantehi phalam acchidā ti.
ja338:4.1: Yam etaṃ parisappasi ajā kāṇā va sāsape yo p' āyaṃ heṭṭhato seti etam pi viditaṃ mayā ti.
